summary: Mission Produce filed an 8-K furnishing an Investor Day press release and updated presentation (Items 7.01/8.01/9.01). The Item 8.01 disclosure confirms activity under the previously announced June 8, 2026 $100 million stock repurchase authorization, with 290,994 shares bought back fiscal Q4 to date at an average price of $12.94. Management unveiled five-year targets of mid-single-digit organic sales growth, 300 basis points of margin expansion, and a 2035 ambition to double sales and triple Adjusted EBITDA. No deal terms or advisors were disclosed; watch execution against buyback pace.
